settings.efficiencyPolicy.title: Efficiency policy
settings.efficiencyPolicy.description: Workflow runs skip the Claude reviewer only for low-risk, fully-verified changes (e.g. exact-content or docs-only). Sensitive paths, large changes, and prior retries always require review.
settings.routingPolicy.title: Routing policy
settings.routingPolicy.description: AO picks who plans, implements, and reviews deterministically: trivial tasks prefer Codex, normal/high-risk tasks prefer Claude Code, and the reviewer always prefers the opposite provider from the worker. If a preferred provider is unavailable, AO falls back to the other one, or waits for capacity rather than failing.
settings.sessionLifecyclePolicy.title: Session lifecycle policy
settings.sessionLifecyclePolicy.newSessi: Task boundary, provider switch, or dead session
settings.sessionLifecyclePolicy.compactV: Many fix cycles/attempts, or real context pressure
settings.sessionLifecyclePolicy.descript: AO reuses a session by default within the same task. It starts a new session at a task boundary, on a permanent provider switch, or when a session is dead/ambiguous — handing the new session a compact, fact-only context pack instead of the old transcript. Fix cycles still reuse the same session by default; a compact recap is added only after many cycles or a real capacity signal.

settings.project.repositoryConnectivityN: Each repository's autonomous worktrees branch from its own base branch shown here — repositories without one fall back to the project's default branch. Testing connectivity uses that repository's own Git configuration (its existing SSH keys, host aliases, or credential helper), never the desktop's signed-in gh account. A failed test only blocks actions that need the remote (push, PR, deploy); local autonomous work is unaffected.
settings.project.directBranchNote: AO works directly on this branch in the registered repository. Only one modifying workflow can use it at a time; others wait until it is free. No temporary worktree and no ao/* branch are created.
settings.project.sessionPrefixNoGitNote: In direct-branch mode the session prefix only names sessions. It no longer creates Git branches.
settings.project.gitMergeNotApplicable: Merge does not apply in direct-branch mode: AO works on the configured branch itself, so there is no separate work branch to merge.
